description: The line plot illustrates the evaluation of different models based on the ratio of activated parameters, with the y-axis representing the evaluation score (Eval PPL) and the x-axis showing the activated parameters ratio in percentage. The x-axis is labeled "Activated Parameters Ratio(%)" and has a linear scale ranging from 25% to 100%. The y-axis is labeled "Eval PPL" and also has a linear scale, with values ranging from approximately 11.5 to 14.0. The plot includes four lines representing different models: a dashed red line for the Transformer, a solid grey line for Only MoHD FNN, a solid blue line for Only MoHD ATTN, and a solid blue line with a diamond marker for MoHD ATTN + MLP. The Transformer line remains relatively flat across the x-axis, indicating a stable evaluation score. The Only MoHD FNN line shows a slight increase in evaluation score as the activated parameters ratio decreases. The Only MoHD ATTN line shows a more significant increase in evaluation score as the activated parameters ratio decreases, with a notable peak at around 50% activated parameters ratio. The MoHD ATTN + MLP line shows a steep increase in evaluation score as the activated parameters ratio decreases, with the highest evaluation score at 25% activated parameters ratio.
